correctness.rationale: With X∼N(d,s), O=(L−|X|)₊ and positive overlap iff |X|<L, the two metrics are Gaussian smoothings of a tent and an interval indicator. The tent's distributional second derivative is δ₋L−2δ₀+δ_L, yielding F′=φ_s(d)[exp(−L²/(2s))cosh(dL/s)−1]. With z=L²/(2s) and a=2d/L this gives the sign of H_a(z)=log cosh(az)−z. For a≤1 it is strictly negative for z>0, including a=0. For a>1, H_a starts at zero with slope −1, is strictly convex and grows to +∞, giving one positive crossing and a unique maximum in s. At a↓1, H_a(C)→H_1(C)<0 for each C>0, so z_F→∞; (a−1)z_F=log 2−log(1+exp(−2az_F)) proves the claimed onset. F is continuous at zero. Differentiating Gaussian interval mass gives the difference of the two weighted densities in the record, with one positive zero at the stated s_P when d>L and strictly negative derivative when d≤L. At d=L the mass tends to 1/2 as s↓0 but the deterministic positive-overlap probability is zero. For d>L, layer cake expresses F as the integral of the narrower interval probabilities with half-width u∈(0,L). Their maximizing variances are q(u)=d²(u/d)/artanh(u/d), strictly between q(L)=s_P and d². Their derivatives are strictly positive at s_P and negative at d²; integration proves the strict ordering. An independent root bisection and split-at-zero quadrature give σ_F=0.6081417030881335, F=0.32447563410484603 and P=0.657492697428084 in the printed example. The supplied checker was read, not run.

value.rationale: Expected overlap and probability of any overlap are both natural measurements but are not interchangeable. The interval L/2<d<L has opposite initial responses for these two metrics in the same model. The touch discontinuity, distinct variance optima and strict comparison establish more than a generic nonmonotonic effect. The sharp offset thresholds and quantitative onset tell a researcher exactly when the qualitative distinction matters.
residual_risks: The conclusions are for fixed equal-width windows and a Gaussian relative onset; they do not establish heterogeneous field responses, fitness, or intervention advice.
